name: events
description: Amazon EventBridge helps you to respond to state changes in your Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: activate-event-source
subcommands.description: Activates a partner event source that has been deactivated.

subcommands.name: cancel-replay
subcommands.description: Cancels the specified replay.

subcommands.name: create-api-destination
subcommands.description: Creates an API destination, which is an HTTP invocation endpoint configured as a target for events.

subcommands.name: create-archive
subcommands.description: Creates an archive of events with the specified settings.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a connection.

subcommands.name: create-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates a global endpoint.

subcommands.name: create-event-bus
subcommands.description: Creates a new event bus within your account.

subcommands.name: create-partner-event-source
subcommands.description: Called by an SaaS partner to create a partner event source.

subcommands.name: deactivate-event-source
subcommands.description: You can use this operation to temporarily stop receiving events from the specified partner event source.

subcommands.name: deauthorize-connection
subcommands.description: Removes all authorization parameters from the connection.

subcommands.name: delete-api-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified API destination.

subcommands.name: delete-archive
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified archive.

subcommands.name: delete-connection
subcommands.description: Deletes a connection.

subcommands.name: delete-endpoint
subcommands.description: Delete an existing global endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-event-bus
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified custom event bus or partner event bus.

subcommands.name: delete-partner-event-source
subcommands.description: This operation is used by SaaS partners to delete a partner event source.

subcommands.name: delete-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified rule.

subcommands.name: describe-api-destination
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an API destination.

subcommands.name: describe-archive
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an archive.

subcommands.name: describe-connection
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a connection.

subcommands.name: describe-endpoint
subcommands.description: Get the information about an existing global endpoint.

subcommands.name: describe-event-bus
subcommands.description: Displays details about an event bus in your account.

subcommands.name: describe-event-source
subcommands.description: This operation lists details about a partner event source that is shared with your account.

subcommands.name: describe-partner-event-source
subcommands.description: An SaaS partner can use this operation to list details about a partner event source that they have created.

subcommands.name: describe-replay
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a replay.

subcommands.name: describe-rule
subcommands.description: Describes the specified rule.

subcommands.name: disable-rule
subcommands.description: Disables the specified rule.

subcommands.name: enable-rule
subcommands.description: Enables the specified rule.

subcommands.name: list-api-destinations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of API destination in the account in the current Region.

subcommands.name: list-archives
subcommands.description: Lists your archives.

subcommands.name: list-connections
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of connections from the account.

subcommands.name: list-endpoints
subcommands.description: List the global endpoints associated with this account.

subcommands.name: list-event-buses
subcommands.description: Lists all the event buses in your account, including the default event bus, custom event buses, and partner event buses.

subcommands.name: list-event-sources
subcommands.description: You can use this to see all the partner event sources that have been shared with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-partner-event-source-accounts
subcommands.description: An SaaS partner can use this operation to display the Amazon Web Services account ID that a particular partner event source name is associated with.

subcommands.name: list-partner-event-sources
subcommands.description: An SaaS partner can use this operation to list all the partner event source names that they have created.

subcommands.name: list-replays
subcommands.description: Lists your replays.

subcommands.name: list-rule-names-by-target
subcommands.description: Lists the rules for the specified target.

subcommands.name: list-rules
subcommands.description: Lists your Amazon EventBridge rules.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with an EventBridge resource.

subcommands.name: list-targets-by-rule
subcommands.description: Lists the targets assigned to the specified rule.

subcommands.name: put-events
subcommands.description: Sends custom events to Amazon EventBridge so that they can be matched to rules.

subcommands.name: put-partner-events
subcommands.description: This is used by SaaS partners to write events to a customer's partner event bus.

subcommands.name: put-permission
subcommands.description: Running PutPermission permits the specified Amazon Web Services account or Amazon Web Services organization to put events to the specified event bus.

subcommands.name: put-rule
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the specified rule.

subcommands.name: put-targets
subcommands.description: Adds the specified targets to the specified rule, or updates the targets if they are already associated with the rule.

subcommands.name: remove-permission
subcommands.description: Revokes the permission of another Amazon Web Services account to be able to put events to the specified event bus.

subcommands.name: remove-targets
subcommands.description: Removes the specified targets from the specified rule.

subcommands.name: start-replay
subcommands.description: Starts the specified replay.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified EventBridge resource.

subcommands.name: test-event-pattern
subcommands.description: Tests whether the specified event pattern matches the provided event.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified EventBridge resource.

subcommands.name: update-api-destination
subcommands.description: Updates an API destination.

subcommands.name: update-archive
subcommands.description: Updates the specified archive.

subcommands.name: update-connection
subcommands.description: Updates settings for a connection.

subcommands.name: update-endpoint
subcommands.description: Update an existing endpoint.

subcommands.name: update-event-bus
subcommands.description: Updates the specified event bus.
